title: New Filing Address for Courier Delivery Services to USCIS Phoenix Lockbox
paragraphs: U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services has changed the filing location for courier delivery services to the Phoenix lockbox. The facility has moved to Tempe, Arizona, and the filing location for courier delivery services for UPS, FedEx, and DHL has also changed to Tempe. The filing location remains the same when using the U.S. Postal Service.

We will forward any applications, petitions, or requests received in Phoenix via courier delivery services to Tempe between March 30 and April 28. After April 28, we will not accept courier delivery at the previous address.

OurLockbox and Service Center Filing Location Updatespage provides an up-to-date summary of changes we make to any lockbox filing location. For the most current information on where to file, please see the Where to File section on the webpage for your form.
You can also subscribe to the Lockbox and Service Center Filing Location Updates GovDelivery distribution list to receive an email each time we update a filing location.
